canonical_industry_source: Must equal one of the canonical `industry` strings already governed in src/finengine/catalog.py's GROUPS industry scope_value and documented in docs/MASTER_SCHEMA.md, so a company's existing reviewed industry classification is what selects this pack -- no new classification taxonomy is introduced.
notes: sector_specific_fields is not_applicable for asset management: catalog.py's 'asset_management' GROUPS entry only defines asset_management_operations KPI fields, with no distinct sector-specific statement template.

AUM composition (institutional_aum, retail_aum, equity_aum, fixed_income_aum, money_market_aum, alternatives_aum) is kept recommended rather than required because not every listed asset manager breaks down AUM by both client type and asset class in every reporting period -- requiring the full cross-tab would make the category chronically understated for managers that disclose only one dimension.

performance_fees and investment_performance_vs_benchmark are the two fields most dependent on fund-level rather than company-level disclosure; where an issuer manages multiple funds against different benchmarks, this pack requires the company-level aggregate the issuer itself states, and a missing company-level aggregate is unavailable (not_disclosed) rather than an average computed across funds without AUM-weighting.
